result.summary:
REQ-VALIDATOR round 2 verdict: FAIL. All 12 round-1 findings are resolved in substance, but the rework leaves 2 BLOCKING defects (N1, N2) and 2 REQUIRED fixes (N3, N4). 7 small items (M-a..M-g) are cheap to fix in the same pass. Research (step 1) must not start. Re-validation: a new round, step-00b-req-validator-r3.json. Line numbers below are docs/requirements.yaml (288 lines, mtime 14:12:44Z, unchanged since the analyst's rework).

ROUND-1 FINDINGS
B1 resolved. AC4 (274) requires «$10 в месяц», «допущение», «Claude», «Copilot», «Pretty Prompt» on the value line and the «why not in Claude/Copilot/Pretty Prompt» content; AC5 (275) FAILs a sentence that omits it; description 192-195. Test: a sentence without Pretty Prompt gives grep -cF = 0.
B2 resolved in substance; two follow-ups open (N2 wording, N3 counting). «по существу» / «оформление» / «третий по счёту»: 0 hits. Any 2b FAIL gives «рано» (AC6, 276); no -rN for 2a/2b (description 263); the writer's result.self_check carries the command output (AC4, 274). Word-level diff: nothing else in the gate changed.
B3 resolved. Fresh snapshot (207 files): the new pattern gives 0, the old pattern step-01- gives 9.
B4 resolved. snapshot-diff on synthetic snapshots: exit 1 without --allow STATE.md, exit 0 with it, exit 1 if docs/requirements.yaml changed after the snapshot (as designed). AC14 (284) orders in_progress before the snapshot and freezes requirements.yaml until step 5 or blocked.
B5 resolved as ORCH ruled (no mandate change). New AC15 (285) is executable: jq -r .task.description | grep -F finds each phrase; artifacts_in count works. Mandates stay frozen (the snapshot-diff allow list excludes .claude/agents/). Follow-ups M-a, M-b are open.
M1 resolved (regex gives 3 of 3 test lines, the old one 1); locale caveat M-c.
M2 resolved. AC1 (271); jq artifacts_out gives exactly one own path per researcher on the previous run's handoffs.
M3 resolved (AC10, 280).
M4 resolved (AC18, 288); M-f.
M5: AC3 wording resolved (273). AC16 (286) now lists criteria numbers, but «4» is mis-scoped: open, part of N1.
M6 resolved (description 227-236 names the origin; 1 500 / 60 words marked as the analyst's); wording problem N2.
M7 resolved. «входит в подписку» has 0 hits; the pointer research/pixel-office.md 167-169 is correct; the Claude row is attributed to the reviewer §3.
Also verified: title, owner, status, depends_on and original_request are byte-identical to round 1 (cmp); the quotes still equal reviews §4 and §3 word for word; no speculation or bar-lowering words (0 hits).

NEW FINDINGS
N1 BLOCKING, testability/consistency: AC4 (274), AC5 (275), AC16 (286). Criterion 4 describes the file at the moment of step 2a (one «## » heading, value section, table). It is re-applied to the final file: AC16 makes step 3 check «4» for the 14-day outcome, AC4 says «те же команды (шаг 2b, RELEASE-VALIDATOR)», and step 4 checks every criterion but the last. Measured on synthetic final documents:
 - 14-day document: grep -c '^## ' returns 9, and the criterion requires 1.
 - «рано» document: every V command returns 0 (V | wc -l = 0, table header count 0), because the value section is removed by design.
 A correct run therefore fails AC4 at step 3 or 4 unless the validator improvises, so a legitimate «рано» can be blocked. I missed this in round 1 (AC4 already said «те же команды»); AC16's «4» came from my own M5 suggestion and made it visible. Fix:
 - AC4: the commands run on the file only at 2a/2b; the single-heading rule is checked only at 2b through result.headings.
 - At steps 3-4: 14-day outcome = V commands and the table header on the final file, without grep -c '^## '; «рано» outcome = the same commands on `jq -r .result.value_sentence` of the 2a handoff, and the rest through the 2a/2b handoffs.
 - AC16: «4» becomes «4 (кроме правила единственного заголовка)».
N2 BLOCKING, fidelity (nothing attributed to the owner that he did not say): description 200 and AC6 (276) «(план владельца, п. 3)»; description 227 «Не из списка владельца (раздел 4 файла отзывов)». The plan is ORCH's (reviews §4 is titled «План ORCH, предложенный владельцу»; the owner said only «Делай», §5), and original_request itself says «текст ORCH, дословно». Fix: «план ORCH, одобренный владельцем («Делай»), п. 3» (twice) and «Не из плана ORCH (раздел 4 файла отзывов)».
N3 REQUIRED, consistency with WF-07: AC6 (276) demands «ровно один файл step-02a-* и ровно один step-02b-*» (ls | grep -c). WF-07 lines 67-72 and AP-006: an agent stopped twice is closed FAILED/not_agent_attested and a NEW run is sent. That incident has already happened in this pipeline (the API limit stopped this very step). The re-run has no defined file name, and -rN means a rework with result.changes. Fix: «ровно один handoff 2a с заполненным result.value_sentence и ровно один 2b с result.verdict (jq -s по step-02a-*/step-02b-*); прерванный запуск (FAILED, not_agent_attested) — не доработка; имя повторного запуска — …-runN.json».
N4 REQUIRED, Sai delta (external service needs a failure criterion; Q10 in spirit): description 266-267 says Q10 is not applicable because there are no external calls «из кода продукта», but the gate depends on live web pages. AC5 (275) makes 2b open at least one link per table row, and any 2b FAIL is an irreversible «рано». If a page does not open (403, timeout, paywall) no listed FAIL condition fits and PASS is impossible, so the owner would be told «ценность не убедительна» because of a fetch failure. REQ-005 had reworks; the 2b gate has none. Fix in AC5:
 - an unopened link goes to result.unopened (address and cause), and the fact is checked through another link of the same row;
 - if no link of some row opens and there is no other FAIL reason, ORCH re-runs 2b (same mechanism as N3);
 - after a second failure REQ-006 is blocked with «источник недоступен», not «рано».
 Adjust description 266-267 accordingly.

SHOULD-FIX (small, do in the same pass)
M-a Description 241-246 and AC15 (285): WF-07 also names REQ-005 at lines 48, 85, 86 (step 5 done/blocked). The description lists only 6, 20, 37, 44, 46, and AC15 leaves step 5 out. My round-1 list missed them too. Add them and add step 5 to AC15.
M-b AC15 (285): «строку, начинающуюся с» cannot be checked with grep -F; use grep -c '^Дополнительные источники этого прогона:'. Each phrase must be on one line: measured, a phrase wrapped by a newline gives grep -F = 0, a false FAIL. An executed handoff cannot be edited afterwards, and re-dispatching 2b conflicts with AC6, so ORCH should run the same jq | grep on each handoff before sending it.
M-c AC13 (279), AC12 (282): Cyrillic grep -i and [[:alpha:]] depend on the locale. Under LC_ALL=C: grep -ciE 'кпп' on «КПП» gives 0 and the M1 regex on «активные пользователи» gives 0 (C.UTF-8: 1 and 1). Prefix these commands with LC_ALL=C.UTF-8.
M-d AC10 (280) vs AC4 (274): the value line's claim about competitors cannot carry «(источник: research/<файл>.md)» because ".md" adds a second [.!?] mark (AC4 allows one). State in AC10 that the sources for the value line are the table directly below it, and in AC8 that a quoted rejected sentence is a quotation, not a fact of the document.
M-e AC8 (278): the reasons from 2b are not checked mechanically (only the phrase, by grep -F). Say «дословно», grep -F each reason, and record which AC4 command or AC5 condition fired, so the owner can tell a form failure from a content failure.
M-f Description 263: «как в WF-07» is wrong for step 5 (WF-07 has no rework limit there; it is the new rule from M4). AC18 (д, 288): say who returns the status to in_progress. Step 5's own context.agent_run_id is checked by nobody; add it to ORCH's check. AC14 (284) says «это требование … не меняется» in the same sentence that flips its status: add «кроме поля status».
M-g AC17 (287): «со своим agent_run_id» was changed to «с заполненным» without a finding. Harmless (BP-20260929-01 reworks reuse the resumed agent's id), so «своим» never meant a distinct id. Noted so the change is visible.

RULINGS ON THE ANALYST'S OPEN QUESTIONS
(1) Limit and five strings can decide «рано» with no gate rework: ACCEPTED. The owner's plan says «Отклонил — стоп». The limit is satisfiable: a compliant 48-word sentence with all five strings passes every AC4 command, and each of 7 adversarial variants is caught (two sentences, over 60 words, missing Pretty Prompt, sentence wrapped over 2 lines, text after the terminal dot, a dot inside «claude.ai», a second heading). The writer's self-check before 2b is not a gate rework (the verdict-giver has not seen the sentence), and 2b re-runs the commands. The numbers are labelled as the analyst's (233-236), and the owner may widen them. Conditions: N1, so the commands are bound to the right input; recommended M-e.
(2) AC15 fixes exact phrases ORCH must copy into task descriptions: ACCEPTED. The check is deterministic (synthetic handoffs: grep -F finds each phrase; artifacts_in count = 2). Mandates stay frozen, which is the option I offered in round 1. Conditions: M-a, M-b.
Round-1 sizing ruling stands: 18 criteria, no split.

CHECKS I RAN (own runs; scripts in the scratchpad, nothing written to the project)
- On-disk state: requirements.yaml mtime 14:12:44Z, 288 lines; my r2 handoff was PENDING with result null, ORCH's context.interruptions preserved.
- Word-level diff of round 1 against round 2 (git diff --word-diff on the text extracted from my round-1 read): every change is accounted for. The unreported ones are M-g and the move of the 2-3 pages clause from AC9 into the description.
- ruby Psych parses REQ-001..006 (8 keys each). REQ-006: status pending, depends_on [REQ-005], 18 criteria, each with «Проверка:». The verbatim script confirms the plan quote equals reviews §4, the reviewer quote is in §3 (bold removed), and «> Делай» is in §5.
- Cited lines printed and compared: README.md 420-421, 503, 504, 570, 571, 578-580, 586, 593-595; research/pixel-office.md 167-169; plan-validator.md 20, 35-36; plan-writer.md 21-25; WF-07 6, 20, 37, 44, 46 (and 48, 85, 86, unlisted). All say what REQ-006 claims.
- tools: node v22.21.1. npm run snapshot on a fresh copy (207 files, sha256sum equals shasum). The AC14 grep gives 0 on the current snapshot (old pattern 9). snapshot-diff with the exact AC14 allow list, including --allow STATE.md, exit 0 on identical trees; synthetic-snapshot exit codes as under B4.
- Synthetic documents: AC4 commands on a compliant brief (all pass), 7 adversarial briefs (each caught), the final 14-day file (h2 = 9) and the final «рано» file (all V = 0); AC7/AC8 heading lists (diff), AC7 value line equals value_sentence (cmp), AC9 word count and forbidden words, AC12 section awk and grep (clean 0, leak 1); AC2 first ### heading, table header grep -Fxc = 1 with 11 columns; AC15 jq/grep on a synthetic handoff; AC1 jq artifacts_out on the previous run; AC18 awk on the real STATE.md section (5 items) and anti-patterns.md (last AP-013).
- Locale test: the same Cyrillic greps under C.UTF-8 and C differ (M-c).
- Sweep of Q1-Q14 and R1-R3, as in round 1. No bar lowering. Q8, R3 are not applicable. Q10: N4. R2 is covered by AC12's demo rule. Q13, Q14 are covered by AC18. The requirement asserts no market fact: whole-session review in Claude Code is posed as a question; competitor names come from project files.
